owner_fixed_requirement: An unfinished current user task may not be silently abandoned for unrelated work; unrelated task switching requires explicit current-user consent and a verified task transition.

baseline.mechanism: same-holder same-session follow-up admission binds execution/request continuity but not unrelated task identity/switch consent

v1_target_evidence.interpretation: mechanism tests passed on accepted target, but candidate is not promotable because runtime owns DDL

adversarial_falsification.problem: V1 request returns challenge_id and raw consent_nonce to the same caller; V1 grant accepts that nonce as sufficient grant evidence with caller-presented snapshot. A buggy or overprivileged integration caller can request then self-grant without a separately authenticated user decision.
adversarial_falsification.restart_variant: Persisting GRANTED without durable identity of the independently verified user-decision receipt prevents a later consumer from distinguishing legitimate consent from legacy/self-granted state.
